findings.highlight: Shinji doesn't have a single one of the traits Tohsaka is expecting in a Master.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂が追っている魔力の気配そのものを、慎二は持っていないのだから。
findings.governingReading: 魔力の気配そのもの is the particular detectable energy that Shinji lacks, with Master ruby identifying its bearer.
findings.explanation: The specific magical-energy signature Rin tracks becomes every trait she expects in a Master.

findings.highlight: I realize I'm staring because of her appearance, and I'm embarrassed for a moment
findings.evidenceJa: 格好が格好だからまともに見るのは恥ずかしいんだけど
findings.governingReading: 格好が格好だからまともに見るのは恥ずかしい says her outfit makes looking directly embarrassing. It does not report that he noticed himself staring.
findings.explanation: Embarrassment that makes looking at Rider difficult becomes embarrassment after realizing he is staring.

findings.highlight: Why are all Heroic Spirits so beautiful?
findings.evidenceJa: 英霊っていうのは、こう美人ぞろいなんだろうか。
findings.governingReading: 美人ぞろいなんだろうか questions whether this holds generally on the basis of Shirou’s small sample.
findings.explanation: Wondering whether Heroic Spirits are all beautiful becomes asking why they all are.

findings.highlight: looking up at Rider's face out of sheer curiosi
findings.evidenceJa: 怖い物見たさでライダーの顔を見上げていると
findings.governingReading: 怖い物見たさ describes the impulse to look precisely because the object frightens him.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s attraction to a frightening sight is flattened into sheer curiosity.
